span.style: background-color: transparent; color: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255)); text-wrap-mode: nowrap;

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));
